prompt:
You are given one rectangular tile board on a 7 by 7 grid. Read rows from the left labels and columns from the top labels. Every column has exactly one green [#37B94B] tile. When those tiles fall vertically until blocked by a black [#000000] tile or the bottom edge, how many cells does the farthest-falling tile move?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to the ordered [row, col] path of the uniquely farthest-falling tile from its start cell to its final cell.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the maximum downward drop distance in cells as an integer.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]],"answer":2}
